title: Verify E170 declared source byte reads
changes: Correct the E170 source-byte regression to allow a fully managed source union, retain explicit owner checks and verify an uncovered inverted-backing control.
validation: Wine ffhtpvms passes all 10,948,338 unique source bytes, 43,793,352 byte reads and 8,186,274 aligned covered word checks; protected inputs passed, scratch was removed and Wine drained. Build ou5f9uch passed.
Initial Wine unit 8oo4pd4m failed only at an invalid combined counter assumption; its diagnostics remain retained.
limitations: Returned values do not attribute every source byte to an owner; guest execution, arbitrary unaligned interiors, timing, other platforms and overall ROMDATA-05 equivalence remain unproved.
